name: Model Badge
description: Keeps each chat target's avatar showing the badge of the model its session will use next. Every picture is generated on the host at runtime; no art is shipped.

providers.label: Providers
providers.help: Channel providers to drive, e.g. ["signal"]. Each reads its own block below.

signal.accountId.label: Signal Account
signal.accountId.help: freeclaw Signal account id (channels.signal.accounts.<id>). The daemon is resolved from this account; empty uses the default account.

signal.groups.label: Signal Groups
signal.groups.help: Which groups this agent paints: { mode: all|include|exclude, ids: [group ids] }. Default all. Every member of a Signal group shares its avatar, so when another agent runs model-badge in a group, exclude it here (or include only yours). An excluded group is skipped entirely: never captured, never painted.

signal.groups.mode.label: Group Mode
signal.groups.mode.help: all (default): every group the account is in. include: only the listed ids. exclude: every group except the listed ids.

signal.groups.ids.label: Group Ids
signal.groups.ids.help: Signal group ids (base64, as listGroups reports them) for include/exclude. Case-insensitive.

signal.profileSessionKey.label: Profile Session
signal.profileSessionKey.help: Session whose model the account's own profile avatar shows. Empty leaves the profile alone.

signal.profileBaseImage.label: Profile Base Image
signal.profileBaseImage.help: Optional absolute path to a local picture used as the profile base. When empty, the profile base is a portrait-safe abstract from the image generator (or vector art without one).

operators.label: Operators
operators.help: Authenticated sender ids (as the gateway reports them) allowed everything: global style rules, any target, status all, audit, purge.

badges.label: Badge Rules
badges.help: Ordered rules mapping model ids to marks: { pattern (regex), letter, color (#RRGGBB), textDark? }. Unmatched models get a generated mark.

targets.label: Target Overrides
targets.help: Per target id: { motif: rings|waves|facets|dots, palette: ocean|forest|dusk|ember|slate|plum|sand|mint, base: adopt|generate }. base adopt (default) keeps a group's own avatar as its background; generate always uses a generated base.

steering.allowGroupMembers.label: Members May Act On Their Group
steering.allowGroupMembers.help: Default on. Group members may restyle, repaint, regenerate and check the status of the group they are in, by asking the agent or with /badge. Global rules and other groups stay operator-only. Turn off for operator-only.

imageGen.label: Image Generation
imageGen.help: Optional, image first: when set, every base is a real image from this generator (vector art only until a target's first image exists). OpenAI-compatible endpoint or a local command; keys by SecretRef only.

paths.stateDir.label: State Directory
paths.stateDir.help: Defaults to <gateway state dir>/plugins/model-badge. Must be readable by the channel daemon (Signal attaches avatars by path).

imageGen.maxPerRun.label: Images Per Pass
imageGen.maxPerRun.help: Most images generated in one pass (default 16). Lower it for metered backends.

imageGen.maxPerDay.label: Images Per Day
imageGen.maxPerDay.help: Daily image budget (default 200, UTC day). Lower it for metered backends.

imageGen.maxAttempts.label: Image Attempts
imageGen.maxAttempts.help: Attempts per target before giving up until its inputs change (default 10; backoff capped by timing.imageGenMaxBackoffMs, default 30 min).

imageGen.promptWriter.label: Scene Writer
imageGen.promptWriter.help: A new group's image scene is written by the agent from the group name and its own memory (ARCH §2c.11). Only used when imageGen is loopback, a private address or a local command; otherwise the motif scene is used.

imageGen.promptWriter.enabled.label: Write Scenes For New Groups
imageGen.promptWriter.enabled.help: Default true. Off: every generated base uses the motif scene.

imageGen.promptWriter.model.label: Writer Model
imageGen.promptWriter.model.help: provider/model for the writer run. Default: the agent's default model.

imageGen.promptWriter.timeoutMs.label: Writer Timeout (ms)
imageGen.promptWriter.timeoutMs.help: Default 60000. A timed-out writer falls back to the motif scene.

imageGen.promptWriter.memory.label: Use Agent Memory
imageGen.promptWriter.memory.help: Default true. Off: the writer gets the group name only, no memory snippets.
